|game_text=Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except [[Control]]) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under [[Credits Will Do Fine]]. May not be [[Disarmed]]. Immune to [[You Are Beaten]] and attrition.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5)]], the Players Committee card image (uploaded by 25 February 2013). Other versions: [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5)]] (original), [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2) and [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4, the current text). The image here is that card image ([[:File:VB5-L-masterquigon-pre.gif]]). How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' ([[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. Immune to Disarmed, You Are Beaten, and attrition.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 45. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> The slip prints the take-into-hand icon (▲); the wiki writes it out (“take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”), as the card list does.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 21 March 2011, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook<ref name="pcforum-p608385">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 21 March 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p608385 forum post])</ref>. It took “Disarmed” out of the immunity list and added “May not be Disarmed.” in front of the immunity, with a comma after “You Are Beaten” (Appendix A of Advanced Rulebook 2.0, p. A-15, PDF created by 27 August 2012, retypes it without the comma; a rulebook is not a card document, so that is not a version): “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. May not be Disarmed. Immune to You Are Beaten, and attrition.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) moved “May not be Disarmed.” to the end, after the immunity, without the comma after “You Are Beaten”: “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition. May not be Disarmed.”<ref name="cl-1250_44-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-masterquigon-pre.gif]], marked E; on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual5-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: <code>masterquigon.gif</code> last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034659/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>): “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. May not be Disarmed. Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition.” It prints the forum order without the comma after “You Are Beaten”. A capitals or punctuation difference in a card document is a version (versions ruling of 9 November 2026), and a card image is placed at its date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, 09:14). Its date is the folder's bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; the version order follows that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, 08:45). The card image shows the card's art, prints the errata mark E bottom right and no slip number.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Master Qui-Gon (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 4)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 12)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12, page 12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the PC-E1 forum text again, word for word: “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent's Effect, may take an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle, or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. May not be Disarmed. Immune to You Are Beaten, and attrition.” Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026), so the Master List is listed as PC-E4. It is the last published text, so it is the current text. The Master List prints only the lower half of the card (stats and game text), with the errata mark E and no slip number.
